Job Description

Oracle Fusion WMS Technofunctional Consultant

10+ Years Experience • Global Implementation

Job Title: Oracle Fusion WMS Technofunctional Consultant (Senior / Lead / Principal) Experience Required: 10+ Years Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract Location: India (Pan-India / Remote / Hybrid) — with willingness to travel for global rollouts Education: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / M.Tech or equivalent Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Oracle Fusion WMS Technofunctional Consultant with 10+ years of overall experience, including multiple end-to-end global implementations of Oracle Fusion Warehouse Management System (WMS) Cloud. The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of functional warehouse operations knowledge and technical configuration/extension capability, with proven experience delivering multi-country, multi-site rollouts across diverse regulatory and business environments. This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, solution architects, and cross-functional Oracle Fusion (ERP/SCM) teams to design and deliver scalable warehouse solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Functional Consulting & Solution Design

  • Lead requirement gathering workshops with global business stakeholders to understand warehouse operations, inventory strategies, and fulfillment processes across regions.
  • Design and configure Oracle Fusion WMS Cloud to support inbound (receiving, putaway), outbound (wave planning, picking, packing, shipping), inventory management, cycle counting, and cross-docking processes.
  • Define and configure WMS rules, strategies, task types, and labor management setups aligned to client-specific warehouse layouts and operating models.
  • Drive fit-gap analysis, solution blueprinting, and business process re-engineering for warehouse operations during global rollouts.
  • Prepare functional design documents (FDD), business requirement documents (BRD), and process flow diagrams.

Technical Configuration & Extensions

  • Configure and extend Oracle Fusion WMS using Application Composer, Page Composer, Sandboxes, and Groovy scripting.
  • Develop and support integrations between Fusion WMS and ERP/SCM (Inventory, Order Management, Procurement, Transportation Management) using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP web services, and FBDI/HDL templates.
  • Configure and troubleshoot RF (radio frequency) device screens, mobile transactions, and barcode/label printing setups.
  • Support data conversion and migration activities (item masters, locators, on-hand inventory) for warehouse go-lives.
  • Work with technical teams on custom reports, OTBI/BI Publisher reports, and dashboards for warehouse KPIs.

Global Implementation & Rollout Management

  • Lead or support multiple global/multi-country WMS implementations, ensuring alignment with local regulatory, tax, and operational requirements.
  • Manage template-based rollout methodology (global template design, localization, and site-by-site deployment).
  • Coordinate with regional teams, third-party logistics (3PL) providers, and carrier/EDI partners for localized configurations.
  • Support multi-time-zone project delivery and stakeholder management across geographies.

Testing, Deployment & Support

  • Lead SIT, UAT, and Warehouse Simulation/Dry-run cycles to validate configurations against real-world warehouse scenarios.
  • Own cutover planning, go-live execution, and hypercare support for warehouse sites, including peak-volume readiness.
  • Provide L2/L3 production support, root-cause analysis, and performance tuning for live WMS operations.
  • Mentor junior functional and technical consultants across project teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Mandatory Skills

  • 10+ years of overall IT/functional experience, with a minimum of 5–6 years dedicated to Oracle Fusion WMS Cloud (technofunctional role).
  • Proven experience across at least 2–3 full-cycle global implementations of Oracle Fusion WMS Cloud (multi-country/multi-site).
  • Strong functional knowledge of warehouse processes: receiving, putaway, replenishment, wave planning, picking strategies, packing, shipping, cycle counting, and physical inventory.
  • Hands-on configuration experience with WMS rules engine, task management, labor management, and container/license plate management.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Inventory Management, Order Management, and Procurement modules as they relate to WMS.
  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or similar middleware for WMS-ERP-3PL integrations.
  • Proficiency with FBDI, HDL, REST/SOAP APIs, and data migration tools for WMS.
  • Familiarity with RF device configuration, barcode scanning, and label printing (Zebra/label design tools).

Global Delivery Skills

  • Experience working with multi-region client stakeholders, understanding localization requirements (tax, compliance, language).
  • Exposure to global template rollout methodology and change management for phased deployments.
  • Ability to manage or work within distributed, multi-time-zone project teams.

Technical Skills (Preferred)

  • Groovy scripting, Application/Page Composer customizations.
  • OTBI, BI Publisher report development for warehouse analytics.
  • Understanding of OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) fundamentals.
  • Exposure to CI/CD and version control practices (Git, Jenkins) for Fusion configurations.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills, essential for global engagements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation abilities.
  • Proven leadership in guiding cross-functional and cross-geography project teams.
  • Flexibility to work across time zones and travel as required for on-site rollout phases.

Good to Have

  • Prior experience migrating from legacy WMS (Manhattan, SAP EWM, Blue Yonder, HighJump) to Oracle Fusion WMS Cloud.
  • Exposure to Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) or third-party TMS integrations.
  • Experience in retail, 3PL/logistics, manufacturing, or distribution domains.
  • Knowledge of EDI transactions (ASN, 856, 940, 943/944/945) relevant to warehouse operations.
  • Experience with Oracle Process Automation (OPA) for warehouse workflow automation.
  • Exposure to IoT/automation integrations (conveyor systems, automated storage/retrieval systems – AS/RS).

Preferred Certifications (not mandatory)

  • Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM / Warehouse Management Certified Implementation Specialist.
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Foundations Associate or higher.

Job Description

Technical Writer

AI-Augmented Documentation · Terminal Operating Systems (TOS)

Role Overview

We are seeking a Technical Writer who bridges the gap between maritime port logistics, enterprise documentation systems, and interactive learning. In this AI-augmented role, you will use AI tools to generate first-draft documentation from PRDs, Jira stories, source code, and product changes, then apply expert judgment to verify, correct, and finalize it into publication-ready manuals. You will manage documentation updates directly through engineering ticketing workflows—using MadCap Flare and Gitbook to single-source Terminal Operating System (TOS) guides, validating API behaviors through hands-on environment testing, and translating operational logic into clear user documentation and interactive eLearning modules.

Key Responsibilities

•      Use AI to generate first-draft technical documentation and track, prioritize, and complete documentation tickets in JIRA/issue trackers alongside engineering sprints to support continuous API and software releases, keeping pace with release velocity through faster draft turnaround.

•      Generate training materials for end-users to familiarize themselves with TOS end-to-end flows, verifying the content against the system and documentation and refining the AI output for accuracy, tone, and completeness.

•      Conduct hands-on testing and validation in QA/staging environments to verify API behavior, endpoints, and TOS workflows before documenting them, and to fact-check AI-generated drafts against actual system behavior.

•      Single-source, draft with AI, refine, and maintain technical documentation for our Terminal Operating System (TOS) platform using MadCap Flare and Gitbook.

•      Use AI to draft API references, configuration guides, and system architecture guides from source code, specifications, and PRDs, then edit to final publication quality within Flare and developer portals.

•      Design and AI-draft interactive micro-learning courses, simulation scripts, and video walk-throughs for port operators, terminal managers, and system integrators, applying the final instructional-design and quality polish.

•      Collaborate with domain experts—maritime engineers, vessel planners, and TOS developers—to translate complex logistics workflows into accessible technical content.

•      Engineer effective prompts and build reusable prompt templates so AI produces accurate, on-brand, terminology-consistent first drafts of TOS documentation.

•      Critically review AI-generated content to catch hallucinations, factual errors, and gaps—owning final accuracy, style, and sign-off before publication.

•      Continuously improve the AI documentation workflow, feeding product changes, glossary updates, and style rules back into prompts and templates to raise draft quality over time.

Required Qualifications

•      Domain experience in Maritime Logistics or Port Operations: Direct familiarity with Terminal Operating Systems (e.g., Navis N4, COSMOS, Tideworks, or proprietary TOS), container terminal workflows (quay crane scheduling, yard planning, gate automation, vessel stowage), or maritime EDI standards (EDIFACT BAPLIE, COARRI, CODECO).

•      Proficiency with AI writing tools: Hands-on experience using LLM-based assistants (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or documentation-specific AI) to generate and iterate on drafts, combined with the editorial judgment to verify, correct, and finalise AI output.

•      Prompt engineering & AI-output review: Ability to craft precise, context-rich prompts and to critically evaluate generated content for factual accuracy, completeness, and terminology consistency.

•      Hands-on API & Environment Testing Experience: Ability to navigate developer staging environments, perform functional testing, and follow JIRA/issue-tracking tickets through the software development lifecycle (SDLC), using that testing to validate AI-drafted content.

•      Proficiency with MadCap Flare: Hands-on experience in single-sourcing, topic-based authoring, condition tags, target management, and multi-channel publishing (HTML5/PDF).

•      Technical Writing experience for developer software: Experience documenting APIs or system integration points, including editing and fact-checking drafts to publication quality.

•      Proficiency with eLearning and Authoring Tools: Experience building interactive courses using tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, Camtasia, or Adobe Captivate.

Preferred / Bonus Qualifications

•      Prior experience working on-site at a container, bulk, or intermodal terminal.

•      Familiarity with SCORM/xAPI standards and LMS integration.

•      Experience with Git version control for integrating Markdown streams into MadCap Flare.

•      Basic understanding of code samples in Python, Java, or C# for API integration guides.

•      Experience defining AI documentation standards—prompt libraries, style guides, or terminology glossaries that keep generated content accurate and consistent.
